ShortDescription.Value: Group buildings into collections and fill a whole city block with them in one click.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Why this mod exists** It started with collections: I saw JustJoeG using a mod he had made himself to keep his own collections of buildings, and I wanted the same. Later, watching mods like Placemaker and Street Builder, I realised that a mod that fills city blocks the way I need, with the corners and curves properly covered, would save me a lot of work. So here it is. It has been working well for me, so I'm sharing it in case someone else is in the same situation.
Collections Builder does two things: it lets you keep your own **collections** of buildings, and it uses them to **build whole city blocks** in one go.
**Collections** - A collection is a named list of buildings you pick yourself: a style, a theme, a street mood, anything. - With the panel open and a collection selected, Shift+click a building in Find It or in the game's asset menu to add it, or add everything Find It is currently showing with one button. - With the "Tag collections in Find It" option on, every collection is also a **Find It tag**, so you can browse it straight from Find It. - Browse a collection as cards (thumbnail, name, lot size, level, height), search it, filter it, and remove buildings you no longer want.
**Block builder** - Click a block surrounded by roads, or draw a polygon, and pick a collection. - The mod lays buildings from that collection along every sidewalk, facing the street, with corner buildings on the corners when the collection has them. It also handles curved streets. - Filter by lot width, depth, level and height, and set the density (how much of the street front gets built). - Preview the result as a transparent plan, press Reshuffle for another random layout with the same rules, and press Build when you like it. No zoning needed: **Plop the Growables** keeps the placed buildings from being condemned. - Optional trees in the leftover space inside the block.
**Required mods** - **Plop the Growables**: buildings placed without zoning would otherwise be condemned by the game. - **Anarchy**: needed for the overlap between buildings. The builder tab shows a warning if either is missing.
**Your saves** - The builder only places regular buildings from your own collections (and, if you turn them on, ordinary trees), the same objects you could place by hand. It adds no new assets and does not change any game rules. - Your collections and settings live in the mod's own settings folder, not in the save. - This mod writes nothing to the save. - Keeping the placed buildings from being condemned is done by Plop the Growables, which is why it is a required mod.
**Mixing two collections** - Fill a block from two collections at once and choose the proportion with a slider, for example 70 % of one style and 30 % of another.
**Overlap** - Street lengths are rarely a multiple of the 8 m lot grid, so a strict layout leaves gaps at street ends and along curves. - With "Overlap" checked, neighbouring buildings may overlap each other by up to 2 m at each joint, only as much as needed, so they always touch and the leftover goes to the corner instead of showing as gaps between buildings. Existing buildings are never removed or overlapped. - Overlap uses the **Anarchy** mod: the builder turns Anarchy on while its tab is open and turns it back off when you leave (only if it was the one that turned it on). Uncheck it to build without overlap.
**How it is tested** - Every change to the layout runs through a simulator that builds 103 block shapes (curves, S-bends, triangles and real city blocks taken from the game) with 24 reshuffles, with and without overlap, and checks that corners and sidewalk coverage never get worse. - Every release is then tested in game before it is published. - No amount of testing covers every block a city can have, so if a block comes out wrong, please report it with a screenshot.
Find It is optional (it is only used for adding buildings and for tags). Early version: feedback and bug reports are welcome on the forum thread (linked on this page) or on GitHub: https://github.com/caay2000/CSII-collections-builder/issues
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.3.32 - Open corners at both ends of a short street get a narrow building of the same model on each street, joined without a gap.
0.3.31 - Open corners are now planned first: their pair is chosen before filling the streets, so far more corners get one.
0.3.30 - Corners next to a short street are paired on every reshuffle, not only on some.
0.3.29 - Corners where a straight street meets a curve are now paired too.
0.3.28 - Overlap is now a single checkbox: buildings overlap up to 2 m at each joint, only as much as needed. - Open corners can use the left and right versions of a corner building turned sideways, with the long facade on each street and the short one at the corner.
0.3.27 - Open corners from 95° to 150° are built with the same building on both streets.
